result.summary: The home feed looks mostly intact; the only visual defect is the last restaurant name in the Fastest row being cut off mid-word.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you row, the third restaurant name is truncated to “Trattoria Piccol” with no ellipsis, so the title is incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card titles with a max-width and ellipsis (or wrap) so names remain readable even when the last card is only partially on screen.
